method: paired re-evaluation of the m2_fc_thrust v1.1 flights: F_acc_c = (F_acc - D_model)(1 + c e)/(1 + e) + D_model with c = sd / 0.03 (FC estimate only, flights unchanged); stuck-pintle ramps with e -> c e and the same noise samples; miss at T <=> no held-20 ms excursion above T before the onset and none within 2 s after it
note: false_L: Pc-lost runs (thrust_scale 1.143) whose held maximum in the fc window exceeds T (of 500 per profile); false_H: healthy runs (of 1000); miss_670 / miss_876: stuck-pintle cases (of 4000: 1000 healthy-run error sets x F0 500 / 150 N x 2.5 / 3.6 kN/s) without an abort within 2 s; early_*: held excursion above T before the onset (an alarm at F0, counted apart); *_gauss: normal fits (model-dependent tails); one-sided 95 % upper bound with 0 observed: 0.30 % per Pc-lost flight (1000 flights). The 4000 stuck cases reuse the 1000 healthy-run error sets (4 ramp cases each), and a miss is driven by the run's bias, so the effective sample for a miss rate is about 1000 (0 observed: upper 95 % 0.30 %), not 4000
